resource_policy.memory_fraction: computed from the selected device's free memory; never hardcoded at 0.95
resource_policy.containers: exact-name registry only; no broad prefix/label cleanup

initialisation.freeze_rule: Gemma LLM + SigLIP backbone frozen; LoRA and four action/time projections trainable

data.cross_event_window_exclusion: training and evaluation windows whose 10-step action crosses the recorded perturbation frame are excluded
data.sample_weighting: clean/recovery 50/50; recovery categories equal; episodes equal within a category

amendment_v1.reason: category B contributes zero episodes to this round (e4t_protocol.json perturbations.mechanism_amendment_v21 withdrew the gripper-command slip because its physical replay diverges), so a weight on B would sample an empty group
amendment_v1.rule: the pre-registered clean:recovery = 1:1 balance is kept and the recovery half is split equally between the two categories that exist

optimisation.data_loader_workers_note: prefetch processes for the training loader only: the frozen sampling plan fixes the batch index sequence, so this changes throughput, not what any batch contains. The first run at workers=0 measured 1.2 s/update (30,000 updates would need 10.0 h against the then-registered 8 h training wall limit), which is why the knob is exposed instead of being left hard-coded at zero.

training_wall_limit_amendment_v1.reason: measured steady throughput on the registered card is 1.054 s per optimizer update (540 updates in 569 s at step 2752), so 30,000 updates need 8.78 h and cannot finish inside the pre-registered 8 h wall limit
training_wall_limit_amendment_v1.conflict: the registered 30,000-update target and the registered 8 h training wall limit are mutually unsatisfiable on this hardware at batch 8
training_wall_limit_amendment_v1.chosen_resolution: keep the 30,000 updates, batch 8, the LR schedule, seed, sampling plan and checkpoint interval unchanged, and widen only the time guard to 9 h
training_wall_limit_amendment_v1.round_budget_check: the 24 h round started 2026-10-25T17:20Z; a 9 h training segment starting ~06:05Z ends ~15:05Z and leaves the round inside its total budget

checkpointing.orbax_directory_offset: directory name is loop index; actual TrainState.step is recorded by read_train_state.py

metric_aggregation_amendment_v1.kind: measurement correction before the final gate summary; no threshold changed
metric_aggregation_amendment_v1.reason: the first pass collapsed the three paired noise copies into their arithmetic mean, which is not a trajectory the sampler emits: it understates continuous error and turns one-frame gripper transitions into a ramp, so the discrete key-event timing cannot be measured at all (0/82 mean-trajectory crossings against 52/82 windows with a per-copy crossing). The registered rule also requires episodes, not windows, to receive equal weight inside a group.
metric_aggregation_amendment_v1.primary_operator: per sampled noise copy; mean over copies, then mean over windows inside an episode, then equal weight per episode; P95 over every elementwise joint error on the sampled trajectories
metric_aggregation_amendment_v1.event_timing_operator: each sampled trajectory paired independently with the ground-truth event of the same arm; maximum absolute frame offset over all pairs and copies

validation_gate.activity_definition: ground-truth action max absolute per-frame change >= 0.02 deg or gripper change >= 0.05 percentage points
validation_gate.activity_threshold_provenance: moved out of the literal in scripts/so101/evaluate_e4t_openloop.py into this file; the floor is checked against the per-frame expert action deltas of the 40 train episodes in experiments/so101/e4t-activity-calibration.json
validation_gate.fk_tcp_error_mib: not reported: the pinned OpenPI model has no SO101 FK interface and this round performs no physics rollout

best_checkpoint.primary_objective: macro MAE over clean and post-disturbance recovery active windows; the two groups receive equal weight, episodes within each group equal
best_checkpoint.first_filter: gripper and event-timing metric must pass
best_checkpoint.claim: diagnostic checkpoint selection on a validation set that has already informed the protocol; it is not an independent final test
